newsitem.title: JAPAN: Idemitsu Petrochemical to raise polystyrene price.
newsitem.headline: Idemitsu Petrochemical to raise polystyrene price.

text.p: Idemitsu Petrochemical Co Ltd, a subsidiary of refiner Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd, said on Monday it would raise its selling price for polystyrene from December due to a rise in the price of naphtha, the main ingredient.
The price of polystyrene products will be raised by about 15 yen per kilogramme reflecting strong naphtha prices and the yen's weakness against the dollar, the company said.
A company official said Idemitsu Petrochemical was considering raising the price of its other petrochemical products for the same reasons.
As recently as in September, buyers had accepted an Idemitsu proposal to raise the price of polystyrene by about 10 yen per kilogramme.
"Even though we have just raised prices, we are still struggling to meet costs and need to increase prices further as the price of naphtha is still rising," the company official said.

Idemitsu Petrochemical said it has been scaling back production of polystyrene because domestic demand for the plastic is faltering as electrical appliance makers, the main consumers, are shifting their production bases overseas.
